interface.longDescription: Create, edit, inspect, render, verify, and export XLSX, CSV, and TSV spreadsheets locally. Reuses duya's bundled xlsx office skill. Use Spreadsheets when the durable output or target is a spreadsheet, workbook, sheet, Google Sheet, or CSV file.
